outcome: number of oxycodone 5 mg tablets prescribed at discharge
number of oxycodone tablets consumed during hospitalization
cohort: 416 women who were prescribed an oral opioid following vaginal or cesarean delivery at a single tertiary academic institution between July 2018 and October 2018
finding: The number of oxycodone tablets prescribed at discharge had no association with patient race or inpatient usage regardless of mode of delivery.
mod_finding: The number of inpatient opioid tablets consumed, as well as the number prescribed at discharge, were not statistically different between Black and White women, regardless of mode of delivery.
